description:
Residence visas GoThere has researched for Americans moving abroad.

    Covers Spain, Ireland, Italy, Mexico and Portugal today. Each option
    carries the income threshold, fees, processing time, years to permanent
    residence and citizenship, each with its source URL and the date it was
    last checked.

    Args:
        country: Optional ISO alpha-2 code or English name, e.g. 'es' or 'Spain'.
        category: Optional 'digitalNomad', 'passiveIncome' or 'work'.
name: get_visa_options
title: Get residence visa options
